Something's wrong with the latest v4.29.0-rc7 toolchain bump:

ctchou-macair:~/play/cslib-lts-work $ lake exe cache get
Current branch: HEAD
Using cache (Azure) from origin: leanprover-community/mathlib4
No files to download
Already decompressed 8184 file(s)
ctchou-macair:~/play/cslib-lts-work $ lake build
✖ [436/803] Building proofwidgets/widgetJsAll
error: ProofWidgets not up-to-date. Please run lake exe cache get to fetch the latest ProofWidgets. If this does not work, report your issue on the Lean Zulip.
Some required targets logged failures:

  • proofwidgets/widgetJsAll
    error: build failed

I am pretty sure I have already downloaded the new toolchain's cache.
I would try removing the .lake directory and getting the cache again.
OK, that works. Thanks! I usually don't have to that, though.
There are occasionally issues where lake can get into a bad state, see #general > ProofWidgets not up-to-date for more context
